rule.title: Nontaxable combat pay is on line 1i only when the election is made

when_missing.because: Nontaxable combat pay is not elected into earned income unless a preparer says so

citation.wording: If you elect to include your nontaxable combat pay in your earned income when figuring the EIC, enter the amount on line 1i.

rule.open_point: Line 1i is not in line 1z, so the answer moves no income total. Each spouse makes the election for their own combat pay, so it is asked per W-2.
